messages:
olivia: FYI merchant CORS Corp sent a SOC2 evidence request asking for: SBOM, CVE remediation timeline for our runtime deps, and confirmation of KMS key rotation policy. They want an ETA within 10 business days.

ravi: Copy. Can you paste the specific deps they flagged? I have the customer thread open.

olivia: They attached a scanner report. Two findings flagged as 'high': dependency "fast-serve" 1.2.3 (CVE-2025-9999) and a transitive in "protoc-util" 0.8.0 (CVE-2024-3333). Also asked whether private deployments have audit logging for RBAC changes.

sec-scan-bot: Vulnerability scan completed. Summary: 2 HIGH (fast-serve@1.2.3, protoc-util@0.8.0), 4 MED, 12 LOW. Full report: https://internal.report/scans/1831234

sam: fast-serve is used in the serving runtime image on hosted and dedicated. We have a patched 1.2.4 internally but not rolled to Dedicated pools yet. Protoc-util is pulled by developer-tooling image; private builds may include it.

anna: Customer is asking for remediation timeline in the SOC2 questionnaire, so we need conservative ETA + mitigation controls. Can we propose a staged rollout: patch hosted first, then dedicated, then private customers, with canary for FE and runtime?

olivia: Proposed plan: 1) push fast-serve 1.2.4 to hosted in 48h (canary 5%), 2) schedule dedicated pool update in week 2 (maintenance window), 3) provide private customers a patch bundle and guidance for on-prem. For protoc-util, mark as low impact for runtime but provide sbom note and upgrade guide.

james: Question on KMS: merchant asked if our private deployment supports customer-managed key rotation schedule and if audit logs capture key-access events. Short answer: yes for Private with KMS integration; logs exist but our default retention is 30d. We need to confirm retention requirements for SOC2 evidence.

sec-lead: For the SOC2 response, we should include: - SBOM export (s3 link) - CVE triage notes (why we prioritized fast-serve) - Mitigation & ETA table - KMS config screenshot + audit log excerpt. Also call out compensating control: WAF rules and temporary URL blocking for the vulnerable endpoint.

ravi: Customer requested a signed attestation and a target remediation date. Can we commit to dates in the next 7 business days for hosted? They escalate if not.

olivia: I'll draft the attestation and timeline today. Sam, can you confirm the canary pipeline and the rollback playbook? Also need a snippet of audit log showing RBAC role change events for private tenants.

sam: Canary pipeline ready. Rollback playbook is the same as the last runtime release; I'll paste steps in a follow-up gist. I can extract RBAC log sample by EOD.

anna: I'll assemble the SOC2 packet (SBOM + CVE notes + KMS logs) and share a signed PDF. Tagging sec-lead for review :eyes: 

sec-lead: Review once posted. Also add the PR numbers for the patches and the internal security approval checklist (control IDs). We'll aim to respond to the customer within 48 hours with the evidence and remediation plan.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and drop links here when available. :thumbsup:
